fix_subject: Fix INTERNAL error from EXPLAIN (FORMAT) and EXPLAIN (FORMAT default)
pr_title: The EXPLAIN transformer read option.children[0] unconditionally for the

labels.summary: EXPLAIN (FORMAT) with no argument, or with DEFAULT stored as an expression, read option.children[0] on an empty vector and raised an INTERNAL error; bare FORMAT now throws InvalidInputException and a bare DEFAULT selects the default renderer.
